title: A bounded-below section model computes the actual derived functor
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with derived categories, A with enough injectives and K-injective resolutions, F:A→B additive, and H a functor on cochain complexes with a natural augmentation F(complex)→H(complex). Suppose H inverts bounded-below quasi-isomorphisms and the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism on bounded-below complexes of injectives. For every integer a and each complex K strictly zero below a there is an isomorphism RF(QK)≅Q(HK), natural for all maps between such complexes. Derived functors have the convention of [def-sp-kinjective-bridge].

source.place: Tag 09A2, comparison with bounded-below injective resolutions.

proof.text: Choose bounded-below injective resolutions using Mathlib’s proved existence theorem. Their terms are concrete complexes; resolution uniqueness supplies only equality information. The resolution map, the assumed augmentation, and the K-injective derived unit give the desired isomorphism.

Lift each coefficient map to the chosen injective resolutions up to homotopy. Use the existing AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.map_eq_of_boundedBelow_homotopy from [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-hypercover-computes-bounded-complex] for both Q followed by RF and H followed by Q. Its bounded-below cylinder argument identifies the two homotopic maps. Naturality of the derived unit and of the augmentation gives the comparison square.

theorem boundedBelow_sectionModel
    {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    {B : Type u} [Category.{z} B] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{z} B]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A] [EnoughInjectives A]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] (H : CochainComplex A ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex B ℤ)
    (α : F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶ H)
    (hH : ∀ (K L : CochainComplex.Plus A) (f : K ⟶ L),
      QuasiIso f.hom → QuasiIso (H.map f.hom))
    (hα : ∀ (J : CochainComplex.Plus A), (∀ n : ℤ, Injective (J.obj.X n)) →
      QuasiIso (α.app J.obj)) (a : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) (_ : K.IsStrictlyGE a),
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (H.obj K),
      ∀ (K L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hK : K.IsStrictlyGE a) (hL : L.IsStrictlyGE a)
        (f : K ⟶ L),
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫ (e L hL).hom =
          (e K hK).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (H.map f)
